text:
emma_csm: Orion Systems dedicated bring-up tomorrow 08:00 PT. Final check: quota, autoscale, soak plan. Need heads-up to customer and cost delta. :wave:

leo_infra: Proposed reserved: 12x A100 (40GB). Customer asked to start at 8 and scale to 12 if needed. I prefer reserve 10 and allow autoscale to 12 for headroom.

nina_sre: For autoscale, suggest policies:
- add instance when avg GPU util > 65% for 3m
- remove when <30% for 10m
- cooldown 2m between scaling actions

mike_ml: Load profile should be 50% chat (1.2k tokens), 30% embeddings, 20% short gen. I'll provide a seed set and expected QoE thresholds.

emma_csm: @mike_ml drop seed and the exact loadgen flags here pls.

mike_ml: seeds: s3://orion/onboard/seeds-v2.txt

mike_ml: loadgen cmd:
```
loadgen --target https://dedicated.redwood/orion --qps 200 --duration 3600 \
  --profile mixed --seeds s3://orion/onboard/seeds-v2.txt --timeout 10s
```

leo_infra: I'll run prewarm 20m before start to warm KV + model cache.
prewarm script:
```
./infra/prewarm_pool.sh --name orion --minutes 20
```

ops-bot: Scheduled event created: 1745556000  orion-dedicated-provision

paul_account: Confirmed with customer: they accept starting at 8 instances if cost delta < 18% week1. I'll share the estimate after infra posts numbers.

nina_sre: Add canary: 1 instance handling 3% traffic for first 8m, then 10m ramp to 25% before full traffic.

leo_infra: Added fallback route to hosted models at the same model family if p95 > 2.5s for 2 consecutive mins.

emma_csm: Also want a quick enablement run for their SREs: 09:15 PT call to walk runbooks + fallback. @paul_account can you invite them?

paul_account: On it. Calendar invite sent to orion-eng@smtp and ops alias.

emma_csm: We'll capture feedback post-run. Quick survey link: https://forms.redwood/bringup-feedback

leo_infra: I'll post perf logs to #ops-dashboard and tag with customer:orion, env:dedicated.

mike_ml: If we see >5% 429s, drop qps by 15% and re-evaluate cache hit ratio.

nina_sre: Agreed. Check-in at 07:40 PT for final go/no-go.

emma_csm: Thanks team. See you at 07:40. :thumbsup:
